beats.say: Billboard says her first Australian number one is her sixth top ten.
Born 1 July 2003, she won Best Female Dancer in 2013. Her second album Think Later arrived in 2023.
Housewife became her first Australian number one and sixth top ten, lifted from her fourth album.
In 2025 her third album So Close to What topped the US Billboard 200.
Will her next single top the charts too? Tell us below.

meta.title: Tate McRae hits #1 in Australia 🎶
meta.summary: Tate McRae’s single Housewife topped the Australian ARIA chart and her third album So Close to What later hit number one on the US Billboard 200.

facts: Tate Rosner McRae was born on July 1, 2003.
She won Best Female Dancer at the Dance Awards in New York City in 2013.
Her second studio album was titled Think Later and released in 2023.
Tate McRae reached number one in Australia with Housewife.
Housewife is the first leader and sixth top-10 appearance on the ARIA Singles Chart for Tate McRae.
Housewife is lifted from the fourth album of Tate McRae.
In 2025, she topped the US Billboard 200 with her third studio album, So Close to What.
So Close to What is her third studio album.

es.title: Tate McRae al #1 en Australia 🎶
es.summary: El sencillo Housewife de Tate McRae lideró la lista ARIA de Australia y su tercer álbum So Close to What llegó al número uno en el Billboard 200 de Estados Unidos.

pt.title: Tate McRae chega ao #1 na Austrália 🎶
pt.summary: O single Housewife de Tate McRae liderou a parada ARIA da Austrália e seu terceiro álbum So Close to What alcançou o primeiro lugar na Billboard 200 dos Estados Unidos.

hi.title: Tate McRae ऑस्ट्रेलिया में #1 पर 🎶
